business_problem: Deputy needed a better way to support multi-tenant workforce analytics and enterprise reporting because customer data was spread across siloed databases, which made reporting slow, governance difficult, and advanced analytics hard to monetize.
solution_summary: Deputy uses Amazon Redshift and Amazon S3 to support multi-tenant workforce analytics and enterprise reporting. The implementation replaced a legacy state where customer data was spread across siloed databases, which made reporting slow, governance difficult, and advanced analytics hard to monetize. Attendance and scheduling events and tenant application data move through production data pipelines and land in Amazon Redshift and Amazon S3, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Central governance keeps access, lineage, and compliance consistent across downstream teams. Amazon OpenSearch Service operationalizes models, agents, and analytics that deliver customer analytics reports and self-service dashboards.
business_outcome: Deputy improved multi-tenant workforce analytics and enterprise reporting with measurable results including faster report generation times from up to 10 minutes, down to 6 seconds, 99% boosted query speed and latency, and 30% enhanced performance for largest customers, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
